build_allreduce_rms_fusion_pass: build a compilation pass that fuses allreduce + RMS norm operations using FlashInfer for tensor-parallel models
create_fused_allreduce_norm_pattern: create a pattern matcher that replaces allreduce + RMS norm without residual with a fused FlashInfer kernel
create_fused_allreduce_rms_quant_fp8_pat: create a pattern matcher that fuses allreduce + RMS norm + FP8 static quantization into a single kernel
create_fused_allreduce_rms_quant_nvfp4_p: create a pattern matcher that fuses allreduce + RMS norm + NVFP4 quantization into a single kernel on compute capability 100
test_allreduce_fusion_pass: test the AllReduceFusionPass by applying pattern matching to an FX graph and verifying kernel fusion replacements
